description: NSFW extra: Windah wins the demon-realm fight and, over the throne, says 'Gua jadi raja Iblis, serius.' Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-rajaiblis/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-rajaiblis.mp4): three pieces (0.6 s padding each) of windah-live9/stream-1959-2059.mp4 (h1, file t 0 = 19:59 WIB) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: A t 3500.20-3508.00 = local 0.60-8.40 -> output 0.00-7.80; B t 3530.30-3534.30 = local 9.60-13.60 -> output 7.80-11.80; C t 3534.40-3538.88 = local 14.80-19.28 -> output 11.80-16.28. NSFW EXTRA (violence/horror theme, user-approved): demon-realm finale in stream order: Jason fires into the fire cave, 'item gendut, hati-hati' (h1 58:20-58:28); after the boss dies and the black screen, the cutscene 'oke oke, we won ... mystery Iblis, ga?' (58:50-58:54); 'iya bener, berarti yang one-hit kill itu yang gendut item tuh. Gua jadi raja Iblis, serius.' over the throne shot (58:54-58:59). Word timings from medium faster-whisper (chat spike #9 58:52 'gg' x91, loudest audio peak of the stream at 58:47 is in the dropped boss cut). BLURRED: the shotgun, Jason's raised arms and the muzzle flash in cut A (box source x480-960, y330-660 for the whole cut); the creature bodies at the left edge of the cave are cropped out (game crop starts at x256). DROPPED: the red horned boss and its gore close-ups (58:41-58:47: bodies and claws fill the frame, blur cannot hide it) and the black screen (58:47-58:50); the clip ends before Jason turns (58:59), whose shirt print reads 'Horny Devil Tour' and a tour list; 'oke what now' (59:01-59:04 afterwards) is left out. No swearing in the cuts; no nudity. The facecam is sharp, its crop stops above the chest logo. Main 16.28 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1248x702 at (256,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 352x264 at (1568,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'GUA JADI RAJA IBLIS', line 2 Volt 'SERIUS', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
